facts.fact: AFP reports that ANSSI-CI, the Agence Nationale de la Sécurité des Systèmes d'Information, led by director general Guelpétchin Ouattara, ran the first national cyber crisis exercise CYBER.EX 2026 on 28-29 October 2026; its creation by law is not stated.
AFP reports that Air Côte d'Ivoire, hit in February 2026 by a cyber-attack that extracted sensitive data, coordinated its response with the national agency, named as ANCI-CI in the text.
